research.recommended_topic: March 31 Year-End Financial Audit: 3 Costly Traps Salaried Indians Miss Before Payroll Closes
research.audience_problem: Salaried corporate professionals in India scramble during late March, facing unexpected TDS cuts, unutilized 80C/ELSS benefits, and missed long-term capital gains tax-loss harvesting because of complex paperwork and tight HR declaration windows.
research.why_now: Financial Year 2024–25 ends on March 31. Indian corporate payroll departments are locking final tax calculations this week, making actionable, urgent financial advice extremely viral and save-worthy right now.
research.hook: March 31st is in a few days, and your HR will not warn you about these 3 tax deductions hitting your April paycheck.
supporting_points: Verify whether your tax slab actually benefits from switching to the New Tax Regime vs Old Tax Regime before final salary computation.
Harvest up to ₹1,00,000 in Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax-free before April 1 to reset your portfolio cost basis.
Submit medical insurance proofs and rent receipts immediately to reverse unnecessary TDS deductions before March 31st midnight.

carousel_outline: Slide 1 (Hook): '1st of the month: Ameer vibes 🤑 | 10th of the month: Bhai splitwise settle kar de na?' Why your salary vanishes without a trace.
Slide 2: Trap 1 - The 'Midnight Swiggy Tax'. Ordering comfort food because din bhar thak gaye the. ₹250 meal + ₹120 delivery, surge, and platform fees adds up to ₹4,500/month.
Slide 3: Trap 2 - The Ghost Subscriptions. Paying for Netflix, Prime, Hotstar, and gym memberships you haven't visited since January. Total leak: ₹2,000+ every month.
Slide 4: Trap 3 - 'Sale Pe Tha Toh Le Liya'. Spending ₹3,000 to save ₹500 on an impulse purchase is still spending ₹2,500 you didn't budget for.
Slide 5: The Fix - The 48-Hour Rule & Salary Day SIP. Add impulse items to cart and wait 2 days. Automate savings before lifestyle expenses kick in.
Slide 6: Summary checklist & prompt: Save this guide to survive the end-of-month crunch.
creation.caption:
Salary credit hone ka SMS aata hai, and within 10 days account balance starts crying.

You are not bad with money—you are just losing it to micro-leaks.

3 simple habits to stop the leakage:
• Cancel any OTT app you haven't opened in 30 days
• Apply the 48-hour wait rule on late-night checkout carts
• Automate your investment on day 1 so you only spend what's left
